render_call_python: render a function call in Python syntax format with backtick delimiters
render_call_yaml: render a function call in YAML format with triple-backtick yaml delimiters
render_call_json: render a function call in pretty JSON format with triple-backtick json delimiters
parse_and_consume_call: parse an LLM-generated function call string and extract targets, function name, args, kwargs, format, and end index
create_tool_callable: create a Tool dataclass instance with name, function, description, and irrecoverable error types for LLM invocation
